title: Chapter 435 - 435 Continuous Level-Ups; Announcement!
content:
Chapter 435 - 435 Continuous Level-Ups; Announcement!

Chapter 435 - 435 Continuous Level-Ups; Announcement!

435 Continuous Level-Ups; Announcement!

Factory Manager Yao’s name was Yao Hanqing.

Even though he was the factory manager, the entire factory did not belong to him alone.

Instead, it was opened by three people, including him.

Normally, it would be difficult for one to even get a job in a factory like this.

If they wanted to sell it, it would be even more troublesome and take a longer time.

After all, everyone had different thoughts.

Some people did it for their ideals, while others did it for their interests…

However, in just two hours, Qinqin Toy Factory quickly drafted the contract and completed the ownership change.

What ideals?

What interest?

In front of two billion dollars, they were nothing!

After the transaction was completed, Yao Hanqing’s entire face broke into a smile.

Lin Fan’s expression remained the same. He focused on the mission system.

[Ding! Mission: Buy one million toys (1 million/1 million) and make 100 different toys. Reward: Perfect artificial limbs, as well as the machinery, tools, and principles for making artificial limbs.]

The mission was already half completed! At the same time, 200,000 red packets instantly appeared on his phone!

However, Lin Fan did not immediately go to collect the red packets.

At this moment, a series of notifications rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! System upgrade, Level 8!]

[Level 8 reward: 200 yuan for every breath; 200 yuan for every second of sleep, and 200 yuan for every step taken. Rewards are distributed at 12 a.m. daily.]

[Upgrade cost: 1.62133 billion/1 billion (not including gifts and gambling. In addition, all items obtained from the system are prohibited from being traded.]

[Ding! [System upgrade, LV9!]

[Level 9 reward: 500 yuan for every breath; 500 yuan for every second of sleep, and 500 yuan for every step taken. Rewards are distributed at 12 a.m. daily.]

[Upgrade cost: 102,330,000/2 billion (not including gifts and gambling. In addition, all items obtained from the system are prohibited from being traded.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve completed the hidden mission. You’ve spent a total of one billion yuan and received five platinum packets!]

As the series of voices rang out in his mind, even Lin Fan could not help but curl his lips up.

He had leveled up two levels in a row!

When he was at level 7, if he only counted the money he earned from breathing, walking, and sleeping, it would be about seven million yuan a day.

At level 9, however, that sum had increased by five times!

In other words, Lin Fan could earn more than 35 million yuan just by breathing, walking, and sleeping every day!

He would get one billion a month!

That was a terrifying number!

In fact, Lin Fan did not care about this bit of money.

The key was the five platinum packets!

Lin Fan had never opened a platinum packet before, but a golden packet had given him Spirit Tea Seeds, double shares coupon, and so on. There was a high chance of him getting good stuff.

Platinum packets were definitely worth looking forward to!

…

After a while, Lin Fan finally collected his thoughts.

He looked at Yao Hanqing, who was holding his phone and counting the balance back and forth. He had yet to leave. Lin Fan asked, “Is there anything else?”

After all, he could leave now that payment had been made.

Yao Hanqing hesitated for a moment and said, “Mr. Lin, I wonder if I can continue working in the factory?

“Don’t worry, I won’t take the shares. I’ll just be an ordinary manager.

“I’ve been a toy worker for more than ten years and a factory manager for a few years. I’ve been in charge of the management, operation, and production of the toy factory, from toy production to offline sales and after-sales… I’m very familiar with the entire process…”

The current him could be said to have complete freedom of wealth.

However, Yao Hanqing had a feeling that if he followed Lin Fan, he would climb higher and go further!

Lin Fan did not care about management, operations, sales, and so on.

However, production?

This was what Lin Fan needed!

After all…

Next, he needed to make 100 different types of toys.

Only then could he complete the mission.

“Can you make 100 different toys?” Lin Fan asked.

Yao Hanqing did not understand why he would ask such a question.

However, he still replied immediately, “If the toy is considered different after slight modifications, then I can make hundreds or thousands of toys!”

Lin Fan nodded. “Alright! Then teach me how to make 100 different toys now.”

Teach him how to make 100 different toys?

Yao Hanqing was stunned again.

This…

A super tycoon who spent two billion yuan to buy a toy factory wanted to learn how to make toys?

“Why? Can’t I?” Lin Fan frowned.

Yao Hanqing quickly said, “Of course… I’ll go to the workshop with you now. There are materials and tools for making all kinds of toys.”

At this moment, in the workshop, a group of workers were either standing and operating machines, doing manual work, or welding.

When they saw Yao Hanqing, they shouted, “Hello, Factory Manager Yao!”

Obviously, these workers still did not know that their boss had been quietly replaced.

Yao Hanqing coughed lightly and said, “Everyone, stop what you’re doing!”

…

When everyone heard this, they stopped their machines and gathered around.

Yao Hanqing continued, “I have something to announce to everyone. From today onward, Mr. Lin is the new boss of our Qinqin Toy Factory!”

Hence, all the employees looked at Lin Fan and said in unison, “Hello, Boss Lin!”

Their change of words could be said to be very simple.

This was normal.

They usually did not interact with people like bosses.

In their hearts…

As long as they worked normally and the boss paid them normally… it did not matter who the boss was.

Lin Fan said, “Hello, everyone. I want to announce something. Qinqin Toy Factory will soon produce some other things. Those who want to stay can continue to stay. If you stay, your salary will double! Those who don’t want to stay can go through the resignation procedures, and we’ll pay N+2 compensation.”

After all, as long as he completed the mission, he would be able to obtain the machinery, tools, principles, and other things needed to make prosthetic limbs.

Since he had bought the factory, he would go with the flow.

Otherwise, it would be a waste.

As for the compensation and doubling their salary, Lin Fan did not care about it at all.

“Really?”

“I’ll get double my salary?”

“I’ll stay!”

“I’ll stay!”

“Me too!”

…

As Lin Fan’s voice fell, the entire factory was filled with intense shouts.

The reason why they came to work in the toy factory was definitely not because they liked toys.

It was just to make money.

Now that they could double their salary, they naturally did not want to miss this chance.

As for what was produced, what did it matter?

Lin Fan nodded. “You don’t have to agree immediately. Today is a paid day off. Go back and think about it. Just come back tomorrow.”
